provenance: Approximate manual readings of NASA SP-8072 (1971), PDF pages 16,20,21,22,23; figures 5,10,12,13,14. Read from rendered 1.5x scans on 2026-10-11. These are curve approximations, not original numerical test data. Estimated reading precision about 1 dB and 10% in position; this is not a statistical uncertainty.
tails: Figure 5 density: +20/-20 dB per decade. Figure 13 density: +10/-30 dB per decade. Figure 12: truncated to 0.1<=x/Lc<=5, optionally renormalized. Figure 14: held at end values. Figure 10: held outside tabulated angle and Sr limits, with warnings.
